corner.preview: Preview: no sign-up yet. Your closet, offers and bids live on this server for testing, under a private tester key in this browser.
shirts.title: Every shirt, every club
shirts.sub: The shirts the clubs' archives document — the ones you can hold, want, swap and sell.
exchange.title: Shirt economy
exchange.sub: Approve and schedule auction lots, handle reports, manage shops, read the audit log.
me.title: Me
me.sub: Your supporter's card, your clubs and your season — kept on this device.
me.card.empty: Your card is blank. Fill it in — two minutes, and it's yours.
me.oath.intro: Written from your card every time it's drawn. Change the card and the oath changes with it.
me.oath.l2: I have since {year} — and that isn't changing.
me.oath.l6: Win, lose or draw — I'll be there.
me.oath.empty: Choose your club on the card and the oath writes itself.
me.story.intro: What you said about yourself, then the days FAN LIFE actually recorded — in order, nothing invented.
me.story.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Play a gate, start a LIFE or hang a shirt in your closet.
me.form.name: Nickname
me.form.nameHint: Up to 18 characters — what fits on a shirt. Only on your own card; other collectors never see it.
me.form.firstHint: A match, a year, a ground — your words.
me.clubs.title: Where you've been
me.clubs.note: Rounds you finished, best scores and your LIFE, club by club. Nothing here can be bought — only played.
me.closet.title: My closet
me.closet.body: {have} shirts in your closet · {want} on your wanted list
me.closet.empty: Your closet is empty. Mark the shirts you own and the ones you're after.
file.title: My file
file.sub: What you made and kept, from every club.
file.xi.title: My all-time XIs
file.xi.none: No XI saved yet. Pick your eleven in any club's All-time XI.
file.life.title: My LIFEs
file.shirts.title: In my closet
file.wants.title: My wanted list
file.been.title: I was there
file.been.none: Nothing marked yet. Open a club's archive or its meetings and press "I was there" on the days you saw with your own eyes.
share3.title: Your card
share3.wordsHint: Printed on the card. Leave it as it is or say it your way.
share3.anon: Shared anonymously unless you sign it.
share3.storyTip: Instagram: save the image, post it as a Story and add a link sticker.
share3.blocked: This card can’t be shared yet: {why}
share3.failed: The card couldn’t be printed here. Try again.
share3.deviceNote: Your result as recorded on this device.
account.title: Keep your card across devices
account.body: Sign in with one Google account and your card, closet and journey follow you from phone to laptop. No form, no password. The archive stays open to everyone.
account.signedIn: Signed in. Your card is saved to your account.
account.failed: Signed in, but saving did not finish. Your card on this device is untouched.
me.closet.identity: You appear to other collectors as {who}.
me.closet.identity.anon: You're anonymous: your closet is private and has no link.
contrib.title: My contributions
contrib.lede: Photos you've taken are yours. Say, photo by photo, whether the editors may reuse one in the club archive, whether it may promote the hub, and how to credit you. Nothing is shared until you say so, and you can take it back any time.
contrib.empty: No photos yet. Add some to a shirt in your closet.
contrib.archive: Editors may reuse it in the club archive
contrib.marketing: May be used to promote the hub
contrib.me.hint: Choose which photos the archive may reuse, and how you're credited.
contrib.admin.title: Photo contributions
contrib.admin.sub: Photos collectors offered to the archive. You see the club, the season and the consent — never who sent it.
contrib.merge.title: Merge two clubs
contrib.merge.hint: Same club entered twice? Items move to the kept entry and the old name stays searchable.
